sources.limits: Do not use public whitepapers or open-source parsers as replacements for the licensed normative books. No specific BDA technical-whitepaper PDF was confirmed as directly downloadable in this audit.

sources.title: ITU-T H.222.0 v10 (04/2025), current edition
sources.classification: normative international recommendation; official freely downloadable PDF
sources.location: 2014 PDF table of contents checked directly: clause 2.4.3.2 Transport stream packet layer, 2.4.3.3 semantics, 2.4.3.4 adaptation field, 2.4.3.6 PES packet, 2.4.3.7 PES semantics; 2.4.4 PSI. The 2025 v10 text was not accessible anonymously and its detailed clause numbering was not independently checked.
sources.license_or_access: Official record available; anonymous download attempt returned TIES login HTML. PDF access requires TIES credentials in this environment. H.222.0 (10/2014) was independently downloaded (3,127,517 bytes, SHA-256 6167a8b567ba3094854a7d3e4d8d64657bee19bb6622f3283e956623971e108a) and is superseded; its clauses 2.4.3.2–2.4.3.7 cover TS packet/adaptation/PES syntax, 2.4.4 PSI. Clause 2.6 is descriptors.
sources.limits: Current v10 text not checked anonymously. The superseded 2014 edition only supports applicable foundational syntax comparison, never a claim of v10 compliance. General MPEG-2 Systems TS/PES only; not Blu-ray 192-byte M2TS outer packet, BDMV, IG/PG PID allocation, IGS or PGS rules.
sources.reproducible_command: curl --fail --location --retry 3 'https://www.itu.int/rec/dologin_pub.asp?id=T-REC-H.222.0-201410-S%21%21PDF-E&lang=e&type=items' --output H.222.0-2014.pdf && file H.222.0-2014.pdf && shasum -a 256 H.222.0-2014.pdf
